H1.claim: Initial coupled correspondence under the one preregistered new realization
H1.evidence: All five A--E sets passed; no mask XOR; bitwise diffuse directions/RGB; separate per-tape and mean specular/total bounds passed
H1.limitation: Local fixed states and this one new quartet only; scalar warnings 101/105 retained

H2.claim: Initial LM proposal consistency under coupled samples
H2.evidence: Coupled J/H/latent and chain-derived physical gradient/math and represented delta bounds passed 5/5; uncoupled 0/5
H2.limitation: Common initial physical state only, unchanged inherited bounds; old represented-theta failure 105 remains historical evidence

H3.claim: Coupling preserves close physical trajectories in the new realization
H3.evidence: C Q distance to P0 <= U at every saved common outer-start and accepted-update index in all five pairs; final similarity C 5/5, U 0/5
H3.limitation: Distinct later states and unequal controller histories; not bitwise trajectories or cross-chart/global equivariance

H4.claim: The historical accurate/inaccurate endpoint group pattern persists across tapes
H4.evidence: All 15 new endpoints lie inside only the frozen historical more-accurate ball; seven previously less-accurate endpoints change proximity group
H4.limitation: Descriptive frozen-Q proximity, not proof that no fine-scale regions remain; two fixed realizations only

H5.claim: The physical recovery pattern changes under the new realization
H5.evidence: Original simultaneous success counts P0/U/C=3/2/3 out of five; new counts=5/5/5. Seven fail-to-pass, eight pass-to-pass
H5.limitation: Conditional on old-tape Adam-pretrained states; no population success probability or independent end-to-end replication

H6.claim: Low total RGB and component compensation need separate material assessment
H6.evidence: Saved held-out diffuse/specular residuals remain anticorrelated; their combined squared error exceeds the total squared error. Prior nonrecovery examples remain admitted
H6.limitation: All new arms pass recovery, so an inaccurate new endpoint group is absent; no new replication of low-RGB nonrecovery

H7.claim: Finite precision and controller behavior limit robustness
H7.evidence: All arms saturate damping at 1e8 with zero represented terminal proposals, retained scalar warnings, trial mask changes and unequal controller histories
H7.limitation: No branch crossing or numerical/budget failure observed; float32 versus mask/damping causal contributions are not independently isolated

remaining_limitations: Two fixed quartets, fixed original-tape Adam states, no statistical inference
Raw old/new fitting losses are different objectives; cross-tape rendering comparisons use original external tapes and each seed original P0 gauge
Historical group proximity distinct from recovery and not an optimizer decision
No unbiased material recovery or neural inverse-rendering generalization established
